name: Formation Forms – Contact Form, Powerful Builder
author: AI Publish

sections.description:
Welcome to Formation Forms, the powerful, most secured, Fast WordPress plugin for building, designing, and managing forms on your website. Whether you need a simple contact form, designer form or an advanced custom form, Formation has you covered, Our form wordpress plugin provides you with everything you need to build stunning, beautiful forms all from one place!

Formation WordPress Plugin is a Fast and easy-to-use that helps you create, design, and manage any kind of form on your website. With over 1000+ form templates, 200+ form designs and 100+ Styling options, you can quickly build beautiful forms that match your site’s feel and style.

Key Features

  1. All-in-One Powerful Form Builder
    With Formation, you get access to over 30+ Form Fields, 200+ form designs and templates that are just a click away! Import form templates and form designs instantly, Design your forms with more than 100+ Style Options, customize them with ease and manage all your forms from one user-friendly dashboard.

  2. 200+ Form Designs
    With over 200+ form design options, you have a wide variety of pre-made choices to quickly create any type of form. Whether you need a simple contact form, a custom form, or something more complex, you’ll find the perfect template and design to suit your needs. Easily customize them to match your style and start collecting data in no time!

  3. 30+ Form Fields
    Formation gives you everything you need to create any kind of form, whether it’s a simple contact form, designer custom forms, or advanced forms. Choose from 30+ form fields, including:
    Name, Text, Paragraph, Email, Phone
    HTML, Number, Password, Terms & Conditions
    Links, Time, Date, Radio Buttons, Sliders, Hidden Fields
    File Upload, Image Upload, Recaptcha, HoneyPot,
    Consent Checkboxes, and many more!
    Our Form Plugin also lets you add custom images and descriptions anywhere in your form using the Form Image and Description fields.
    If you need any form fields that aren’t available in the Formation plugin, you can request the feature, and we’ll try to add it as soon as possible. Just email us at support@plugin.net.

  4. Endless Design Options
    With 100+ styling options, customize every aspect of your form’s design. Control background colors, background, borders, fonts, spacing, and much more with our powerful formation form builder. Create forms that match your site’s look and feel!
    If you’re looking for a design or design option that’s not available in the Formation WordPress plugin, you can request it, and we’ll do our best to add it as soon as possible. Just email us at support@plugin.net.
sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Upload the Plugin

Download the Formation Forms plugin from WordPress.org.
Go to your WordPress Dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
Choose the file you downloaded and click Install Now.

  1. Activate the Plugin
    Once installed, click Activate to start using Formation on your site.

  2. Get Started
    You can now start building your forms! Go to Formation → Add New Form to begin creating your first form.
sections.faq:
What is Formation?

Formation is a WordPress plugin for creating, designing, and managing forms on your website. It’s user-friendly, flexible, and powerful, perfect for all types of forms.

Will Formation Plugin slow down my website?

No, Formation is designed to be fast and lightweight, so it won’t slow down your website. It is built with performance in mind. We’ve made sure it works efficiently without affecting your site’s performance. Just remember to keep your WordPress site and plugins up to date for the best experience. If you ever notice any issues, feel free to contact us, and we’ll be happy to help!

What types of forms can I create with Formation?

Formation can create any type of WordPress forms like contact forms, registration forms, custom forms and much more.

Can I customize the design of my forms?

Yes! You have full control over the design with 100+ styling options, including colors, fonts, backgrounds, spacing and many more.

Does Formation support integrations with other 3rd party form plugins?

Yes! Formation integrates with 3rd party form plugins like WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, Contact Form 7, and Forminator. You can use Formation to enhance your form designs while keeping all the core features of your existing plugins.

Is Formation secure?

Yes! Formation includes Honeypot, reCAPTCHA, and WordPress nonce tokens to help protect your forms from spam, security threats and attacks.

Can I request a feature or function?

Absolutely! If you have any feature or design requests, we’d love to hear from you. Contact us at support@plugin.net, and we’ll work to add it in future updates.
